summary: Disconnect a MutationObserver from all nodes and empty its pending record queue.

target.notes: Remove this observer's registrations from observed nodes and empty its record queue.

caveats: disconnect does not destroy the observer; observe() can register it again.

tests.name: disconnect stops later records
tests.input: const n=document.createElement('div'); const m=new MutationObserver(()=>{}); m.observe(n,{childList:true}); m.disconnect(); n.append(document.createElement('i')); console.log(m.takeRecords().length);

tests.name: disconnect discards queued records
tests.input: const n=document.createElement('div'); const m=new MutationObserver(()=>{}); m.observe(n,{childList:true}); n.append(document.createElement('i')); m.disconnect(); console.log(m.takeRecords().length);
